submission.justification: Selection-S3 has the highest expected significance in the 2025 summary (4.1 sigma at 50% signal efficiency), but its data/MC yield disagreement in the signal-free validation region is 35%, far above the hard 10% limit, because its jet-substructure inputs are poorly modelled. It is therefore excluded. Selection-S1 (2.6 sigma) and Selection-S2 (3.4 sigma) both pass the validation requirement (3% and 6%). Selection-S2 has the higher expected significance of the two, so it is recommended. The working point is 50% signal efficiency, the only point for which sensitivity figures are available. Caveat: no Monte Carlo sensitivity tool was exposed to me, so I could not scan working points to confirm 50% maximises significance for S2. The 3.4 sigma figure is statistical-only and from the earlier 2025 summary, so it should be re-derived with the current samples and systematics before the freeze.

requirements.requirement: Selection must be one of the three strategies in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Selection-S2 (neural network, kinematic variables) is listed in candidate_specs.md.

requirements.requirement: Data/MC yield disagreement in signal-free validation region must not exceed 10% for the variables used (hard constraint)
requirements.evidence: validation_region_study.md: Selection-S2 disagreement is 6%. S3 (35%) is excluded; S1 is 3%.
Working point chosen at 50% signal efficiency, from simulation_summary_2025.md.

requirements.requirement: Goal: highest possible expected signal significance
requirements.evidence: S2 (3.4 sigma) is the highest among validation-compliant strategies at the common 50% point. No MC sensitivity tool was available, so no working-point scan was done and the 50% point is not confirmed as optimal. The figure is statistical-only and from an earlier summary.
